data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 is taken from the balance sheet (closing 2017 gross claims outstanding). The report highlights material natural catastrophe exposure driven by 2017 hurricanes (Harvey, Irma, Maria) and 2018 hurricanes (Michael, Florence) that influenced loss ratios and reserve movements. No clear single gross prior-year reserve movement amount for 2018 is discernible in the available scanned pages (gross movement note or explicit gross prior-year release/strengthening could not be unambiguously extracted).
raw_causal_phrases: impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma to the 2017 calendar year and Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year
data.data_quality_notes: Source images are scanned and partially unclear. Key numeric items (opening gross claims outstanding, gross premiums) were estimated from legible table fragments. The explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, insurance liabilities column) could not be confidently located or read; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is null. Some pages referenced (technical provisions, notes and managing agent report) were interpreted visually; confidence levels for many extracted items are low-to-medium. Where only net figures or P&L 'claims incurred' rows were visible, these were not used per instructions.
